desc: Ideation: derive reduction — only adjacent changes (j→j+1, cost 1) beat delete+insert (cost 2); total cost = D + I − Σ min(d_j, ins_{j+1}); for fixed k this is a 2-state DP over 26 letters; k ranges 1..max(cnt); total O(26n).

Implement Solution.makeStringGood: count letters, loop k = 1..max(cnt), per k precompute (del, ins) for both choices per letter, run DP over 26 letters with states (choice of previous letter), answer = min over k of best DP value (fallback ans = n covers delete-all; empty subset never optimal since keeping most frequent letter costs n − max(cnt) < n).

Verify the DP solution against all examples and edge cases: confirm "acab"→1, "wddw"→0, "aaabc"→2, plus hand-checks ("aaab"→1, "abbbb"→1, "bbb"→0, all-same→0, insert-only case), validate the k ≤ max(cnt) bound and the empty-subset argument, and confirm complexity O(26·max(cnt)) fits n ≤ 2·10⁴.
